children: RNS Number : 7193T  Schiehallion Fund Limited (The)  08 September 2026
Change of Administrator, Company Secretary and Registered Office

The Board of The Schiehallion Fund Limited announces that, with effect from 8 September 2026, the Company has appointed Altum (Guernsey) Limited ("Altum") as its new designated administrator and company secretary, in place of Alter Domus (Guernsey) Limited.
Following the appointment of Altum, the Company's registered office has changed to 1st Floor, Royal Chambers, St. Julian's Avenue, St. Peter Port, Guernsey, GY1 3JX.
